title.zh: v2.0.39 底鼓解剖实验室直达指南与工作台回归、声学课程双向跳转、和弦工坊直达钢琴卷帘实时编辑
title.en: v2.0.39 Kick Anatomy Lab Contextual Guide & Studio Return, Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing, and Chord Workshop Piano Roll Bridge

highlights.zh: **底鼓声学实验室专属手册与回归闭环（Kick Anatomy Lab Studio & Manual Integration）**：在底鼓设计/躯体声学实验室（KickAnatomyView）顶部遥测状态栏增设专属磨砂金光指南按钮（底鼓手册，直达混音与声学实验室手册）与高对比度「返回编曲台」快捷入口；全面打通从底鼓瞬态物理建模、低频下潜调试到主工作台的编曲创作流转闭环。
highlights.en: **Kick Anatomy Lab Studio & Manual Integration**: Equipped the Kick Design & Somatic Acoustics Lab with a dedicated frosted gold "Kick Lab Guide" button linking straight to acoustics/mixing documentation, alongside a high-visibility "Return to Studio" action. Creators can effortlessly inspect physical kick synthesis models and seamlessly jump back to the sequencer.

highlights.zh: **交互教学课程声学双向实操跳转（Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing）**：在交互式教学中心第 4 课「底鼓谐振解剖与全景声谱示波器」卡片中引入双向实操跳转架构。提供次要动作「进入底鼓实验室」与主要动作「查看全景声谱分析仪」，学习者可根据学习进度一键直达三段式物理谐振建模或 32 频段 FFT / 李萨如相位视区，彻底消除功能探索的认知割裂。
highlights.en: **Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing**: Upgraded Lesson 4 ("Kick Anatomy & Panoramic Acoustic Scope") in the Interactive Learning Center with dual action routing. Provides direct buttons to both the Kick Anatomy Lab and the Panoramic Analyzer Suite, letting learners jump straight into physical transient modeling or 32-band FFT/Lissajous visualizers directly from the course milestone.

highlights.zh: **和弦工坊直通专业钢琴卷帘编辑（Chord Workshop to Piano Roll Direct Bridge）**：在和弦走向与律动工坊（ChordProgressionsView）顶部工具栏增设专属「在卷帘中编辑」动作。创作者在探索经典或自定义和弦走向后，可一键将和弦载入和弦轨道并自动在工作台唤起专业钢琴卷帘，即刻进行音阶对齐、转位微调、Drop-2 爵士重排或力度动态塑形。
highlights.en: **Chord Workshop to Piano Roll Direct Bridge**: Introduced an "Edit in Piano Roll" action in the Chord Progressions Studio toolbar. Clicking immediately loads the authored chord progression into the sequencer chords track and automatically opens the Piano Roll editor on that track for instant visual editing, inversion adjustments, Drop-2 jazz re-voicing, and velocity humanization.
